The '''Util-313''', also known as '''Jedi shuttle bus'''<ref name="Encyclopedia Starfighters" /> was a model of [[repulsorcraft]] manufactured by [[GoCorp]] that was used on [[Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars]] by members of the [[Galactic Senate]], the [[Republic Military]] and the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="Citadel">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> Util-313s used by [[clone trooper]]s were [[Color|white]] and sported red markings with the [[Republic crest]] to denote its affiliation. At least one such example was present at [[79's]] during the [[Mission to Level 1325|trackdown]] of the clone trooper [[Fives]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War]], Util-313s were used on [[Vardos]], [[Naboo]], and [[Tatooine]].<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>
